Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality experiences for millions of players. What we’re looking for: Experience working on product development, LiveOps, or monetization within mobile free-to-play games. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset (SQL is a plus!). Curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for learning and staying ahead of industry trends. Establish credibility as a scientific expert and resource for internal stake holders, providing medical and scientific support for products and therapeutic areas. Collaborate cross-functionally with medical affairs, clinical development, marketing and other teams to support the development and execution of medical strategies and tactics. Understand the regulatory requirements for customer engagement by field-based employees. Required Skills, Experience and Education: Doctoral degree in scientific or medical discipline. 8+ years experience as an MSL or in a similar role within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry. 3+ years experience as a MSL working in the lung cancer disease state area. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proven ability to analyze and synthesize scientific information effectively. Excellent presentation
